nameOrigin: icy region around the North Pole

pokedexEntries.bk: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.

pokedexEntries.wh: It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with. Cold northern areas are its habitat.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: They love the cold seas of the north. They create pathways across the ocean waters by freezing their own breath.

pokedexEntries.x: They love the cold seas of the north. They create pathways across the ocean waters by freezing their own breath.

pokedexEntries.or: They love the cold seas of the north. They create pathways across the ocean waters by freezing their own breath.

pokedexEntries.y: It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with. Cold northern areas are its habitat.

pokedexEntries.as: It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with. Cold northern areas are its habitat.

pokedexEntries.sw: It swims through frigid seas, searching for prey. From its frozen breath, it forms icy fangs that are harder than steel.

pokedexEntries.sh: It swims energetically through frigid seas. When it gets tired, it freezes the seawater with its breath so it can rest on the ice.

pokedexEntries.sc: It is a ferocious, carnivorous Pokémon. Once it captures its prey, it will breathe cold air onto the prey to freeze and preserve it.

pokedexEntries.vi: Feared as the Snow-White Demon in northern lands, Beartic uses its frosty claws and fangs to attack prey.
